summary: Aegon Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 8, 2026 press release reporting that its Extraordinary General Meeting approved the proposed redomiciliation to the United States and an Omnibus Incentive Plan, with amended bye-laws filed on Form 6-K. The registrant expects to proceed October 15, 2026 with repurchasing all outstanding Common Shares B held by Vereniging Aegon in exchange for common shares with equal voting rights on a 40-to-1 basis. Vereniging Aegon will be renamed Vereniging Aegon Americas and retain roughly 18.4%. A Capital Markets Day is set for December 9, 2027 in New York.
